title: Whole transcriptome-sequencing of CD1c+ conventional type 2 dendritic cells of human non-infectious uveitis patients
description: RNA-sequencing data from MACS-sorted primary CD19-CD303-CD1c+ cDC2s purifed from fresh peripheral blood mononuclear cells from patients with anterior, intermediate, and posterior non-infectious uveitis. Overall design: PBMCs were isolated from heparin blood and subjected to MACS isolation to purify CD1c+ cDC2 cells. Purity was evaluated by flow cytometry and cell fraction subjected to RNA-sequencing by NovaSeq.
